sow.title: Here is how we produce the monthly investment report today

goal.line: Produce the monthly investment report in USD and SGD.
goal.why: To map and automate the current process.
readers: Daniel Foo, the Chief Investment Officer
decisions: Daniel Foo approves the issued report
Questions for managers are logged as open questions

steps.name: Collect the exports
steps.does: Downloads administrator positions export and trading system positions export (CSV) from portals and saves them to the shared file drop under /MonthEnd/<yyyy-mm>/raw. Opens each file, counts rows and compares the row count and control total in the footer line with the file.
steps.control: Row count and file totals match the file (batch_control_totals).
steps.exception: A rejected file is re-requested the same day.

steps.name: Check cash against the administrator
steps.does: Opens the cash tab of her reconciliation workbook (Cash_Recon_<yyyy-mm>.xlsx) and pastes the administrator cash balances beside the trading export balances, one row per entity per day. A formula column shows the difference. Highlights differences over tolerance and opens a break case in the tracker (tab 'Breaks').
steps.control: Difference per entity per day inside cash_tolerance (5,000 USD).
steps.exception: Over tolerance opens a break case (Entity B, 12,400 USD on 8 Oct 2026). Raj is told by email.

steps.name: Collect manager statements
steps.does: Saves the PDF to the manager folder, types the fund, period end, value and received date into the statements tracker (Excel), and checks the tracker against the expected list. For anything late or missing she writes a follow-up email to the manager by hand. Quarterly funds (C, D, E) are carried forward in the months with no statement.
steps.control: Every expected statement received by statement_due (10 business days).
steps.exception: Late or missing: follow-up draft to the manager.

steps.name: Convert to SGD
steps.does: Takes the holdings values from the tracker and the cash from the recon workbook and converts them to SGD in a separate Excel file, looking up the WMR 4pm USD/SGD fixing for the period end in the market data file. The conversion is typed in, not linked.
steps.control: WMR 4pm fixing of the period end (fx_fixing).

steps.name: Review and approve the report
steps.does: Assembles the report pack from the converted figures and sends it for review. A manager estimate may be used in the investment report only.
steps.control: Maker never checker; estimates only in the investment report (estimate_use).
steps.exception: If a late statement revises a value by more than 100,000 USD or 0.5% of a fund, the review is reopened.

steps.name: Read the report
steps.does: Reads the issued pack. Logs questions for managers as open questions.
steps.exception: Questions to managers logged as open questions.

One column per step, in order; a lane for each team. Manual steps are flagged.
sections.example: 1 | Pull custodian file | Operations | Custodian portal
sections.heading: Lanes and steps

rows.name: Collect the exports
rows.does: Downloads administrator positions export and trading system positions export (CSV) from portals and saves them to the shared file drop under /MonthEnd/<yyyy-mm>/raw. Opens each file, counts rows and compares the row count and control total in the footer line with the file.

rows.name: Check cash against the administrator
rows.does: Opens the cash tab of her reconciliation workbook (Cash_Recon_<yyyy-mm>.xlsx) and pastes the administrator cash balances beside the trading export balances, one row per entity per day. A formula column shows the difference. Highlights differences over tolerance and opens a break case in the tracker (tab 'Breaks').

rows.name: Collect manager statements
rows.does: Saves the PDF to the manager folder, types the fund, period end, value and received date into the statements tracker (Excel), and checks the tracker against the expected list. For anything late or missing she writes a follow-up email to the manager by hand. Quarterly funds (C, D, E) are carried forward in the months with no statement.

rows.name: Convert to SGD
rows.does: Takes the holdings values from the tracker and the cash from the recon workbook and converts them to SGD in a separate Excel file, looking up the WMR 4pm USD/SGD fixing for the period end in the market data file. The conversion is typed in, not linked.

rows.name: Review and approve the report
rows.does: Assembles the report pack from the converted figures and sends it for review. A manager estimate may be used in the investment report only.

rows.name: Read the report
rows.does: Reads the issued pack. Logs questions for managers as open questions.

steps.name: Collect the exports
steps.does: Downloads administrator positions export and trading system positions export (CSV) from portals and saves them to the shared file drop under /MonthEnd/<yyyy-mm>/raw. Opens each file, counts rows and compares the row count and control total in the footer line with the file.
steps.control: Row count and file totals match the file (batch_control_totals).
steps.exception: A rejected file is re-requested the same day.

steps.name: Check cash against the administrator
steps.does: Opens the cash tab of her reconciliation workbook (Cash_Recon_<yyyy-mm>.xlsx) and pastes the administrator cash balances beside the trading export balances, one row per entity per day. A formula column shows the difference. Highlights differences over tolerance and opens a break case in the tracker (tab 'Breaks').
steps.control: Difference per entity per day inside cash_tolerance (5,000 USD).
steps.exception: Over tolerance opens a break case (Entity B, 12,400 USD on 8 Oct 2026). Raj is told by email.

steps.name: Collect manager statements
steps.does: Saves the PDF to the manager folder, types the fund, period end, value and received date into the statements tracker (Excel), and checks the tracker against the expected list. For anything late or missing she writes a follow-up email to the manager by hand. Quarterly funds (C, D, E) are carried forward in the months with no statement.
steps.control: Every expected statement received by statement_due (10 business days).
steps.exception: Late or missing: follow-up draft to the manager.

steps.name: Convert to SGD
steps.does: Takes the holdings values from the tracker and the cash from the recon workbook and converts them to SGD in a separate Excel file, looking up the WMR 4pm USD/SGD fixing for the period end in the market data file. The conversion is typed in, not linked.
steps.control: WMR 4pm fixing of the period end (fx_fixing).

steps.name: Review and approve the report
steps.does: Assembles the report pack from the converted figures and sends it for review. A manager estimate may be used in the investment report only.
steps.control: Maker never checker; estimates only in the investment report (estimate_use).
steps.exception: If a late statement revises a value by more than 100,000 USD or 0.5% of a fund, the review is reopened.

steps.name: Read the report
steps.does: Reads the issued pack. Logs questions for managers as open questions.
steps.exception: Questions to managers logged as open questions.
